variant: expl3 property-table cache for GoTo Contents
method: One exploratory direct tagged LuaLaTeX pass, seeded from pair 1 candidate .aux/.toc files used by the paired cache profile. RSS was sampled by ps while LuaTeX emitted LuaTeX memory checkpoints every 100 pages.

run.stop_reason: The property-table variant was far slower than the completed current-cache pass, so the exploratory process was terminated before the final pages.

pdf_audit.reason: The compilation was incomplete; the partial PDF was not audited.

run.cache_hit_miss_metrics: not emitted because the document did not reach end-of-document.

interpretation: The pass did not complete, so it provides no PDF semantic-audit result and no full-run peak RSS.
At the interruption it had spent over 3.5 times the duration of the completed current-cache reference while reporting 933 of 1096 pages.
Partial dyn_used checkpoints were slightly higher than the current-cache checkpoints; this does not support the intended memory reduction.
decision: Reject this expl3 property-table implementation as a full-document cache replacement. Keep it out of production.
